ywc_shu_port_close_unified = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ywc_v03_shu_v03_shu_port_treasury_started
			NOT = { has_variable = ywc_v03_shu_v03_shu_port_treasury_settled }
			NOT = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_outcome }
			ywc_shu_port_terminal_unified_ready = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_outcome value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_advance_unpaid }
			if = {
				limit = { gold_reserves >= { value = var:ywc_shu_port_principal } }
				add_treasury = { value = var:ywc_shu_port_principal multiply = -1 }
				remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_advance_unpaid
				set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_advance_repaid value = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				add_modifier = { modifier = ywc_shu_local_credit_arrears months = 12 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = ywc_v03_shu_v03_shu_port_treasury_outcome value = var:ywc_shu_port_outcome }
		set_variable = { name = ywc_v03_shu_v03_shu_port_treasury_settled value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = ywc_v03_active_arc_count add = -1 }
		change_variable = { name = ywc_v03_visible_task_count add = -1 }
		clamp_variable = { name = ywc_v03_active_arc_count min = 0 max = 3 }
		clamp_variable = { name = ywc_v03_visible_task_count min = 0 max = 6 }
	}
}
